name: What is a granny flat and how does it differ from other home additions?

mainEntity.name: What is a granny flat and how does it differ from other home additions?

acceptedAnswer.text: A granny flat, often referred to as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or a secondary dwelling, is a self-contained living space built on the same property as a primary home. Unlike a standard room addition, a granny flat typically includes its own kitchen, bathroom, and living area, functioning as a complete independent residence. AKN Design Group focuses on integrating these additions seamlessly with your existing property, enhancing both functionality and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: A granny flat is a self-contained living space on your property, distinct from a standard room addition by including its own kitchen and bathroom.
